title: Illustration icons

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Keep explanatory illustration distinct from navigational symbols because different icon roles require different levels of independent recognition.
strategic_value: A clear role boundary can let Helsinki use expressive icons without confusing signage or interface actions.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section describes illustration-icon uses and formats, states prohibited UI/signage uses and shows icons supporting food-station text.
practical_value: Choose illustration icons to accompany explanation, not to replace an action or wayfinding symbol.

content_islands.name: Illustration-icon specimens
content_islands.spec: Begin with two rows of four outlined icons, including a stroller, bird, light bulb, hearts and plug.

content_islands.name: Purpose and contexts
content_islands.spec: Explain text-supported illustration and list applications.

content_islands.name: Role limits and supply
content_islands.spec: State exclusions, source-file information and responsible team.

content_islands.name: Food-station example
content_islands.spec: Show the icons supporting explanatory text.

ingredient.name: Illustration icons
ingredient.role: Support explanatory text and visual storytelling.
ingredient.application: Use for information graphics, presentations, brochures, patterns, posters or products alongside explanatory text.
ingredient.scope: Do not use as UI or signage icons. The source prints a placeholder count of 000, dated August 2022; it is not a verified library size.

reference_purposes.Application: The food-station example pairs icons with explanatory text.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Illustration icons cannot be used as user-interface or signage icons.
